name: Bear Creek Aggregate Expansion
description: Expansion of an existing sand and gravel operation by 42 hectares, including a new processing plant and haul road.

name: Nechako Valley Wind
description: Thirty-six turbine wind facility with a nameplate capacity of 180 megawatts and a 24 kilometre collector line.

name: Salish Sea Ferry Terminal Upgrade
description: Replacement of two berths and a new marshalling area, with dredging inside the existing terminal footprint.

name: Kootenay Biosolids Processing Centre
description: Regional facility to compost municipal biosolids, with sediment control ponds discharging to an unnamed tributary.

name: Peace Region Potato Processing Plant
description: New processing plant handling 120,000 tonnes a year, drawing process water from a licensed groundwater well.

name: Thompson Ridge Ski Resort Master Plan
description: All-season resort with 1,400 bed units, four lifts and a water supply reservoir above the village site.

name: Fraser Lowlands Water Storage
description: Off-channel storage reservoir and pump station to supplement irrigation supply during summer low flows.

name: Skeena Modular Housing Works
description: Factory producing modular housing units, with an on-site sediment settling basin and a rail spur connection.
